# EuroKids

> EuroKids is India's leading preschool chain offering PlayGroup, Nursery, and Kindergarten education through the Heureka curriculum based on Harvard's Visible Thinking methodology.

EuroKids operates across India and Nepal with a focus on early childhood education, franchise expansion opportunities, and corporate daycare solutions. The organization is part of Lighthouse Learning Group and has received recognition through ET Education Excellence Awards and Indian Education Awards.
